  "prompt": "prompts/physics_committee_terra_chair_summary_v1.md",
  "summary": {
    "leading_positions": [
      {
        "ballot_ids": [
          "B051"
        ],
        "explicit_supporters": [
          "kroll-stefan",
          "lindroth-eva",
          "pearce-mark"
        ],
        "synthesis": "These members explicitly prefer optical lattice clocks, citing mature and independently demonstrated precision measurement together with a compact Katori–Ye attribution. They also agree that the historical boundary of the foundational achievement and any indispensable additional contributors require review."
      },
      {
        "ballot_ids": [
          "B006"
        ],
        "explicit_supporters": [
          "danielsson-ulf"
        ],
        "synthesis": "This position prioritizes the opening of high-energy neutrino astronomy as a new observational channel. Its proponent regards the scientific discovery as secure and mature, while treating fair individual attribution within a collaboration-scale observatory as the decisive outstanding constraint."
      },
      {
        "ballot_ids": [
          "B009"
        ],
        "explicit_supporters": [
          "johansson-goran"
        ],
        "synthesis": "This position prioritizes squeezed light as a mature transformation of quantum noise into a usable metrological resource. The underlying achievement is distinguished from later gravitational-wave deployment, and the proposed experimental representation remains subject to historical review."
      }
    ],
    "areas_of_agreement": [
      "Optical lattice clocks are regarded by several members as a mature, reproducible precision-measurement advance with a comparatively compact proposed attribution.",
      "Several leading experimental and instrumental cases require citations that delimit the foundational achievement from broader later applications or infrastructure.",
      "Attribution requires documentary historical review even where the scientific merit and maturity of a proposal are strongly recognized."
    ],
    "scientific_disputes": [
      "Members differ over whether priority should go to a new astronomical messenger channel, a mature precision-measurement platform, controllable squeezed light, a computational method, a microscopy instrument, or a universality-class framework.",
      "There is a substantive distinction between rewarding an experimentally observed discovery or new observational capability and rewarding an enabling computational, theoretical, or instrumental advance.",
      "The relative weight of conceptual universality, direct empirical discovery, and broadly useful measurement capability remains unresolved."
    ],
    "attribution_disputes": [
      "B006 raises whether Francis Halzen, Albrecht Karle, and Christian Spiering fairly represent a large observatory collaboration and its enabling detector work.",
      "B009 requires assessment of whether Carlton M. Caves, H. Jeff Kimble, and Roman Schnabel best represent the theory-to-experiment lineage of squeezed light without absorbing later interferometer implementation.",
      "B051 requires review of whether Hidetoshi Katori and Jun Ye encompass all indispensable early lattice-clock contributions while excluding wider metrological developments.",
      "B046 and B017 require separation of original concepts and practical realization from extensive engineering and facility-level development.",
      "B032 requires clarification of the allocation between the defining KPZ equation and later exact theoretical advances."
    ],
    "maturity_disputes": [
      "B051 is presented as independently reproduced and reliable across laboratories, while its citation should not depend on prospective standards consequences.",
      "B006 is described as scientifically mature, but its observatory-scale form makes maturity of the result distinct from individual-credit maturity.",
      "B009 is described as mature through longstanding experimental realization and precision-interferometry use, while the boundary between foundational squeezing and later deployment remains contested.",
      "B007 and B032 have durable records over decades, but members differ on how to compare methodological or theoretical maturity with directly experimental achievements."
    ],
    "conflict_or_recusal_flags": [],
    "questions_for_round2": [
      "What contemporaneous historical evidence identifies the indispensable contributors to the original magic-wavelength optical-lattice-clock concept and its decisive realization, and does it support a two-person allocation?",
      "Can a citation and three-person allocation for IceCube isolate the discovery of the astrophysical neutrino flux while fairly representing the observatory-scale collaboration?",
      "For squeezed light, which experimental contributions are essential to a squeezing-centered prize, and how should the citation exclude later gravitational-wave-interferometer implementation?",
      "How should the committee compare a new observational channel with mature measurement instruments, enabling computational methods, and theoretical universality frameworks?",
      "What priority record most clearly separates foundational electron-aberration correction and SASE concepts from later engineering, facility construction, and instrument development?"
    ],
    "chair_observation": "Round 1 identifies B051 as the only explicitly shared preferred configuration, while several scientifically strong alternatives remain differentiated chiefly by the balance between discovery type, demonstrated maturity, and the defensibility of individual attribution."
  }
}
